name: voice-ai-copilot
description: Kids Voice AI Copilot (Ages 5-12) with Multilingual Speech, Stories, Math & Science Learning Tutor

scripts.prepare-assets: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); fs.mkdirSync('www',{recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync('www/js',{recursive:true}); fs.mkdirSync('www/css',{recursive:true}); ['index.html','manifest.json','flow-diagram.html'].forEach(f=>{if(fs.existsSync(f)) fs.copyFileSync(f, 'www/'+f);}); fs.readdirSync('js').forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync('js/'+f, 'www/js/'+f)); fs.readdirSync('css').forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync('css/'+f, 'www/css/'+f)); console.log('Assets prepared in www/ directory.');"
scripts.sync: npm run prepare-assets && npx cap sync android
scripts.build:apk: npm run sync && node -e "const {execSync}=require('child_process'),fs=require('fs'),path=require('path'); const jdkPath=path.join(process.env.USERPROFILE,'.jdks','jdk-21.0.6+7'); const env={...process.env,JAVA_HOME:jdkPath,ANDROID_HOME:path.join(process.env.LOCALAPPDATA,'Android','Sdk')}; execSync('gradlew.bat assembleDebug',{cwd:'android',env,stdio:'inherit'}); fs.mkdirSync('apk',{recursive:true}); const src='android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk'; if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.copyFileSync(src,'apk/VoiceAI-Copilot.apk'); fs.copyFileSync(src,'apk/app-debug.apk'); console.log('APK successfully built and saved to apk/VoiceAI-Copilot.apk');}"
